items.question: After the towing vessel City of Louisville ran aground near Thebes, Illinois, to which city's repair yard was it brought, and on what date was it hauled out of the water there?
items.expected_answer: It was refloated and towed to a repair yard in Paducah, Kentucky, where it was dry docked on August 10.

evidence.quote: The City of Louisville was refloated and towed to a repair yard in Paducah, Kentucky, where it was dry docked on August 10.

items.notes: Tests retrieval of the repair location and dry-dock date from the damage section.

items.question: What malfunction in the City of Louisville's autopilot allowed the tow to wander out of the channel while the pilot was away from the helm on the Upper Mississippi River?
items.expected_answer: The premise is wrong: the City of Louisville had no autopilot system; the pilot left the helm unattended, and the probable cause was the pilot leaving the helm, not an autopilot failure.

evidence.quote: saw there was no swing of the tow (the City of Louisville was not fitted with an autopilot system).
the probable cause of the grounding of the City of Louisville was the pilot leaving the helm unattended while operating his tow on the Mississippi River.

items.notes: False premise of an autopilot failure; the vessel had no autopilot and the cause was the unattended helm.
